[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3.25, Hard Mode) |hidden = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Carrot Throw}}''' - The '''Bunny''' throws a carrot which stuns a specific tower and all towers in the immediate impact area. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bunny''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Eggy Island]] as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It appeared in easy mode (with 750 health) and in hard mode (with 2,000 health). The '''Bunny''' moved quite slowly in easy and about average in hard mode. The '''Bunny''' had the ability to throw carrots, which stunned a specific tower and any other towers in the immediate impact area. ==Appearance== The '''Bunny''' had a cat face with bunny ears. It had white skin with a grey egg imprinted on its torso, and a white beard. The '''Bunny''' carried a carrot to throw at towers. When the '''Bunny''' died, a death animation played. ==Strategy== *The '''Bunny''' is probably the first major threat in [[Eggy Island]]. Make sure you have enough [[Minigunner]]s to deal with it, ideally with a [[Commander]] boosting them. **In hard mode, you can also use the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] to deal with the '''Bunny'''. *You can use cheap towers such as the [[Soldier]] and [[Scout]] to distract the '''Bunny''' away from your main towers. **In addition, this will slow the '''Bunny''' down as it needs to stop to attack towers. *The [[Pyromancer]] is recommended to slow the '''Bunny''' down. **In hard mode, you can alternatively use the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]] and [[Frost Blaster]] to slow this enemy down. *Try not to cluster towers close together as the '''Bunny's''' ''Carrot Throw'' can stun all towers close to its intended target. ==Trivia== *The '''Bunny''' was likely based on ''R2DA's'' [[w:c:r2da:Easter Costumes|Easter]] [[w:c:r2da:Brute|Brute]] in terms of attack and appearance. ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Bunny''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Bunny''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Hunter (Eggy Island)|Hunter]]
